arguments: the text after the skill name, or the request in the conversation
read_tool: a shell read of the whole file (`cat` or `sed -n`)
parallel_reads: read all of them in one shell command
start_subagents: start one subagent for each with `spawn_agent`
delegate: Give this job to a subagent with `spawn_agent`, so that you keep working while it reads.
web_search: the web search of Codex, if it is on
ask_user: a question in your reply, and then stop
load_skill: read the `SKILL.md` of the `{0}` skill from the skill list
skill_dir_note: `<skill-dir>` is the base directory of this skill. The skill list gives it.
